featured_reviews.review_text:
Pros
Good connectivity as it is near WE highway and closer to Vile Parle station.
Few people in the society are really nice.

Cons
2 wheelers are parked at the main entrance creating bottleneck with no space for cars to pass. In case of emergency it will be a nightmare to find people to move bikes to create entry for vehicle.

If you are moving there as tenants then pls do your own research. Our experience was bitter. There are few people in society who are just ready to pick a fight and if you are a tenenat then it's worse. No notifications is given to tenants for Water, electricity or Gas disruptions. Tenants have to park their 2 wheelers outside the premises whereas the owners 2 wheelers create bottleneck at the main entrance. Pigeons create havock in the bathroom windows. Society didn't install pigeon net at the duct entrance even requesting it for 1y.
Even the support staff is frustrated and keep changing. Most parking is in the automated car lift and the entrance of the lift is very narrow. If you have a big car  then pls do check if the parking is in car lift. The car lift gets stuck frequently and a tenant having bigger car will be blamed first.
